overviewHtml:
Connects the Cursor editor to a live Dynatrace environment over MCP, bundling one MCP server connection and 30 Dynatrace skills so the coding agent can investigate production issues without leaving the editor.

Debugging a production failure from the editor usually means copying logs into the chat by hand, so the agent guesses without live context. With the plugin, asking why payment-api is returning 5xx pulls the root cause into the session together with the related logs, metrics, traces and CPU/memory profiling from the live environment — and because it draws on Dynatrace causal analysis and Smartscape topology, the agent can explain why it happened rather than inferring from correlation.

What you get

  • A Dynatrace MCP server connection from Cursor to your environment
  • Dynatrace skills for DQL, dashboards, notebooks and alerting
  • Live logs, metrics and traces available to the coding agent
  • Support for private team marketplaces in enterprise setups
getStartedHtml:
You need Cursor and a Dynatrace environment with a platform token.

  1. Open the Cursor Marketplace and install the Dynatrace plugin
  2. Set your environment URL and platform token
  3. Ask the agent about a failing service
